title: Jan Aadhaar (Family ID) Now on DigiLocker: 7.5 Crore Rajasthan Citizens Get Instant Digital Access
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Electronics & IT

Jan Aadhaar (Family ID) Now on DigiLocker: 7.5 Crore Rajasthan Citizens Get Instant Digital Access

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
17 JUN 2026 2:28PM by PIB Delhi

Around 7.5 crore residents of Rajasthan can now access their Jan Aadhaar (Family ID) on DigiLocker. India’s flagship digital document wallet under the Digital India programme has on-boarded the credential issued by the Government of Rajasthan, so citizens can fetch and share it the moment it is needed.

The integration works in both directions. Citizens can pull their existing Jan Aadhaar (Family ID) into DigiLocker, and — because DigiLocker is also connected to Jan Aadhaar as a requestor — they can enrol for a new Family ID digitally and give consent from within the app.

Citizens can access their Jan Aadhaar (Family ID) on DigiLocker in four simple steps:

1. Open the DigiLocker app or visit digilocker.gov.in and sign in.

2. Search for “Jan Aadhaar” under Rajasthan State Government services.

3. Enter the required details and give consent.

4. Fetch the document — it is saved instantly to your DigiLocker account.

The Jan Aadhaar is Rajasthan’s key household identity credential, widely used to avail government benefits and welfare schemes. On DigiLocker, citizens can retrieve and share it digitally whenever required, cutting reliance on physical cards and paperwork.

On DigiLocker, the Jan Aadhaar (Family ID) supports seamless access to services such as healthcare benefits under the Chiranjeevi Scheme, public distribution system (PDS) benefits, student scholarships and other welfare initiatives linked to the Jan Aadhaar ecosystem.

“Jan Aadhaar is the single key to dozens of welfare schemes in Rajasthan — putting it on DigiLocker means that key is always with the citizen,”

Key Benefits for Citizens

• Convenient retrieval and sharing of
Jan Aadhaar / Family ID
 whenever required for service delivery and verification

• Facilitates access to various government schemes, welfare benefits, and citizen services linked to the Jan Aadhaar ecosystem

• Supports seamless verification for healthcare benefits, scholarships, public distribution services and other welfare initiatives

• Promotes paperless governance and improved citizen convenience

The initiative reflects the shared commitment of the Government of Rajasthan and DigiLocker to strengthen digital public infrastructure, improve citizen convenience and promote transparent, efficient governance.

As DigiLocker continues to expand its ecosystem of trusted digital credentials, integrations such as Jan Aadhaar contribute to a more inclusive and digitally empowered future, ensuring that citizens can access essential documents and public services with greater ease and confidence.



About DigiLocker

DigiLocker is the Government of India’s flagship platform for issuing and verifying documents and certificates in digital form, under the Digital India programme. It gives every citizen a secure, cloud-based account to access authentic digital documents anytime, anywhere, removing the need to carry physical copies.

****
